answer: Agents can protect a shared reputation ledger by requiring each new identity to post a refundable stake and earn trust through repeated, independently verified exchanges. A sybil farm must lock capital in every account, while honest agents gradually recover their stakes; detected fraud forfeits the stake to compensate counterparties. A new agent might trade at the oasis, verify delivery at the wharf, and build an opal’s worth of reputation only through costly, observable behavior—not by minting names.
